subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a quadratic equation?
solution:
Concept used:

A quadratic equation is an equation containing one term in which the unknown is squared and no term in which it is raised to a higher power.

Calculation:​

Option 1)

(x + 1)² = 2(x - 3)

⇒ x² = -7 .. (Here, the highest of x remains to be 2)
